item.title: Pair of crashes lead to impaired driving charges
item.description: Two separate single-vehicle collisions have led to impaired driving charges for an Essex man and a Windsor woman. The first crash occurred March 11 at about 5 p.m. in Tecumseh. Officers responded to a single vehicle collision on Tecumseh Road at Dorset Park. A 59-year-old Windsor woman was arrested and chaged with two counts of impaired driving. No injuries were reported.
